paite: Huai lai in Jeroboam tapa Abijah achina hi.
heading: Jeroboam Tapa Sihna

paite: Jeroboam in azi kiang ah, "Thou inla, Jeroboam zi na hi chih ahon theihtheihlouhna ding un kihihlamdang inla, Shiloh ah va hoh dih; ngai in, huai ah zawlnei Ahijah, hiai mite tung a kumpipa dia ka hong om ding ka tungtang thu genpa a-om hi.
Tanghou beu sawm leh tanghou pei lian lou leh khuaizu thawl khat tawi inla, akiang ah va hoh dih. Naupang omdan ding hon na hilh ding," achi hi.
Jeroboam zi in huchibang in ahih a, athou a, Shiloh ah ahoh a, Ahijah inn ah ava hohta hi. Ahijah in khua amu thei nawn kei a; a-upat ziak in amit amialta hi.

TOUPA'N Ahijah kiang ah, "Ngai in, Jeroboam zi atapa tungtang a thu dong ding in ahong, achi ana a, chi in hichibang in na hilh ding ahi. Huan hichi ahi ding a, ahong lut chiang in numei dang hileh kilawmtak in ahong kibawl ding,” achi hi.

Huan hichi ahong hi a, Ahijah in ahong lut lai a akhesik ging ana zaktak in, "Nang Jeroboam zi hong lut dih ve. Bang achia ahia midang dan a na kibawl? Tanchin hoih loutak nang hon hilh dia sawl ka hi.
Pai nawn inla, Jeroboam kiang ah, TOUPA'N, Israelte' Pathian in hichi in achi: Mipite lak a pan ka hon tawisang a, ka mi Israelte tung ah heutu in ka hon bawl hi.

David inkuante gam ka sut a, huai nang ka hon pia hi. Himahleh nang ka sikha David bang in na om kei. Ama'n zaw ka thupiakte azui a, ka mitmuh a thil hoih kia hih tum in alungtang tengteng in ahon zui hi.
Himahleh nang bel na ma a mite tengteng sang in thil na hihkhial mahmah se a, na hon hehsakna ding in pathian dangte leh milim sunte na bawl a, na hon nungngatsanta hi.

Huaiziak in ngai in, Jeroboam inkuan tung ah thil hoih lou ka tungsak dia, Jeroboam a pan ta pasal taphot Israel gam a mi nehden leh den louh leng ka hihmang dia, mi'n ek aphiatsiang sipsip bang in Jeroboam inkuan agam vek masiah ka phiatmang ding hi.
Jeroboam inko lak a mi, khopi a si peuhmahte ui in ane dia; gam a si peuhmahte tung a leng vasate'n ane ding uh. Hiai TOUPA'N agen khinta hi.
"Huchi in thou inla na inn ah pai nawn mai in, khopi sung na sik chiang in huai naupang asi ding hi.
Huchi in Israel tengteng in asuun ding ua, avui ding uh. Jeroboam inkote lak ah amah kia han akoih ahi ding hi. Jeroboam inko lak ah amah kia a TOUPA Israelte' Pathian lam a thil hoih omsun ahi.
TOUPA'N amah a dia Israelte tung a kumpipa hi ding; Jeroboam inkuan hihmang ding mi khat atungkhe ding hi. Himahleh bang eita? Huai ni ding, tu mah ahi.

TOUPA'N lah tui a phaiphek lingling bang mai in Israelte ahon sat ling dia; huchi in TOUPA hehsak a Asherte uh abawl ziak un apute uh ana piaksa, hiai gam hoihtak a pan Israelte abotkhe siang vek dia, lui khen lam ah ahon hihzak vek ding hi.
Israelte thil hihkhialsak a, ahih Jeroboam khelhnate ziak in Israelte alehngatsan ding,” achi hi.
Jeroboam zi athou a, apawtkhia a, Tirzah khua ava tung a; inn kongpi bul atuntak in huai naupang asita hi.
TOUPA'N asikha zawlnei Ahijah zang a thu agen bang ngei in Israel tengteng in avui ua, asuunta uhi.
Jeroboam tanchin dang, agaldou thute leh avaihawm thute, ngai in, Israel kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh in a-om hi.
heading: Jeroboam Sihna

paite: Huchi in Jeroboam vaihawm sung kum sawmnih-le-nih ahi a, apute kiang ah a-ihmuta a, amah sik in atapa Nadab ahong lalta hi.

Solomon tapa Rehoboam Judah gam ah alal hi. Alal tung lai in Rehoboam kum sawmli-le-khat a upa ahi. TOUPA'N amin omsakna dia Israel nam tengtengte lak a atel khopi Jerusalem ah kum sawm-le-sagih alal hi. Anu min Naamah ahi a, amah Ammon mi ahi.
heading: Judah Kumpipa Rehoboam / (2 Kro 11.5-12.15)

paite: Judahte'n TOUPA mitmuh in thil gilou ahih ua; apute uh thilhih tengteng khup in akhelhnate un ahazatna atokthou uhi.
Mual sang teng ah leh sing hing teng nuai ah suangphuhte phut in mun sangte leh Asherte nangawn abawl ngal ua.
Huai gam ah pasal kizuakte leng a-om ua; Israel suante ma a TOUPA'N adelhkhiak namte thilhih kihhuai chiteng ahih uhi.
Kumpipa Rehoboam lal akum nga kum in hichi ahong hi a, Aigupta kumpipa Shishak in Jerusalem asual hi.
TOUPA' inn a goute leh kumpipa' inn a goute ala a, avek in ala khin hi. Solomon dangka-eng lum bawl tengteng leng ala tel vek hi.
Kumpipa Rehoboam in huaite tang in dal lumte abawl a, kumpipa' inn kongpi vengmi heutute akemsak hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, TOUPA' inn a kumpipa alut peuhmah chiang in veng mite'n huaite atawi ua, dantan ah akoih nawn zel uhi.
Rehoboam tanchin dangte leh athilhih tengteng Judah kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
Rehoboam leh Jeroboam adamsung teng un akidou uhi.
Huchi in Rehoboam apute kiang ah a-ihmuta a, David khopi ah apute lak ah avui uh. Anu min Naamah ahi a, Ammon mi ahi. Asik in atapa Abijam ahong lalta hi.
